After getting our helmets on we sit on our go-karts.
It’s a tight fit for me since these are obviously made with children in mind.
I weigh more than {f_botName} so I’m at a disadvantage.
I doubt I will win since she’s got all these sensors and whatnot, but I will not give up easily!
When the green light comes on, the race will start, I need to get my timing right…
